fancybars.bars.config.explanation:
Welcome to the status bars config screen!

Drag and drop the bars to snap them to an anchor (white squares), existing bars or you can put them anywhere.
You can right click them to edit a bunch of properties.
By hovering your mouse between 2 bars (your cursor should change), you can resize them.

Everything is saved when you leave.

Use the ☰ button (or Esc) to go back to the SBCLIENT menu.
fancybars.bars.config.reset:
This will reset the status bars to their default positions.
This cannot be undone.
fancybars.bars.description: Show or hide bars and their icons, and pick their colours.

fancybars.config.actionBarShown.@Tooltip: Show the action bar at all. Move and scale it in the editor.
fancybars.config.actionBarSmoothFont.@To: Use the smooth bold font instead of the pixel font.
fancybars.config.actionBarUseCustomColor: Draw all action bar text in one colour instead of Hypixel's colours.

fancybars.config.chat.dungeonAbilities.@: Hides: Class ability ready / used messages in dungeons

fancybars.config.chat.traps.@Tooltip: Hides: Tripwire, Flamethrower, Arrow Trap and Crusher damage

fancybars.config.crosshairEnabled.@Toolt: Use the crosshair you drew instead of the vanilla one.
Show the crosshair (yours or the normal one) in third person too.

fancybars.config.gifsHideCraftingGrid.@T: Hide the 2x2 crafting grid in the inventory to make room for GIFs.

Original: overflow mana is drawn over the mana bar.
Accurate: the bar is split between mana and overflow mana.
Smallest In Front: whichever is smaller is drawn on top.
fancybars.config.intelligenceDisplay.sho: How overflow mana is drawn on the mana bar.
fancybars.config.invHudBackground.@Toolt: Draw a rounded background behind the inventory HUD.
fancybars.config.invHudEnabled.@Tooltip: Show your inventory (above the hotbar) on screen. Move and scale it in the editor.

fancybars.config.keystrokesRightCps.@Too: Show your right clicks per second on the RMB key.
fancybars.config.ownNametagInF5.@Tooltip: Show your own nametag above you in third person.
fancybars.config.playerSizeEnabled.@Tool: Draw yourself at a custom width, height and length. Only visual, your hitbox doesn't change. Other SBCLIENT users see it once your name is in the shared size list.
fancybars.config.playerSizeHeight.@Toolt: How tall you are (25% – 300%). Your nametag moves with your head.
fancybars.config.playerSizeLength.@Toolt: How deep you are, front to back (25% – 300%).
fancybars.config.playerSizeShowOthers.@T: Show other SBCLIENT users at the sizes in the shared list.
fancybars.config.protectionChatNotificat: Show a chat message when you protect or unprotect an item.
fancybars.config.rareDropsBackground.@To: Draw a rounded background behind the tracker.
fancybars.config.rareDropsChat.@Tooltip: Send a chat message with the drop count and runs since your last rare drop.
fancybars.config.rareDropsEnabled.@Toolt: Count rare dungeon chest drops and the runs between them.
fancybars.config.rareDropsHud.@Tooltip: Show your rare drop counts on screen while you're in the Dungeon Hub. Move and scale it in the editor.
fancybars.config.riftHealthHP: Rift Health: HP instead of hearts
fancybars.config.riftHealthHP.@Tooltip: In the rift, if enabled, the health status bar will display HP (20, 19, 18, ...) instead of Hearts (10, 9.5, 9, ...)
fancybars.config.secretsEnabled.@Tooltip: Show how many secrets you've found in the current dungeon room (from the action bar). Move and scale it in the editor.
fancybars.config.secretsHideActionBar.@T: Remove the "X/Y Secrets" text from the action bar while the display is on.
fancybars.config.secretsShowChest.@Toolt: Show the chest icon next to the secrets count.
fancybars.config.secretsShowWord.@Toolti: Show the word Secrets above the count. Turn off for just the numbers.
fancybars.config.shikiMode.@Tooltip: Switch to the pink ShikiClient look with the Shiki logo, instead of SBCLIENT's pink-to-blue gradient.
fancybars.config.showEstimatedTilde.@Too: Displays a tilde (~) before a bar's value when it is estimated by FancyBars because it is not visible in the action bar.
fancybars.config.smoothBarText.@Tooltip: Draw the numbers on the bars with the smooth Inter font instead of the pixel font.

fancybars.config.viewmodelEnabled.@Toolt: Move, rotate and scale the item in your hand and your empty arm in first person. The off hand is mirrored.

fancybars.config.wallLickerEnabled.@Tool: Count every time you walk face-first into a wall inside a dungeon. On screen "Licks" is this run; the all-time total is below.
